problem: The verify-coverage classifier counted only registered verify:* direct imports and missed real assert-and-exit paths.

decision.decision_summary: Use filename-independent AST/dataflow semantics; reject name-only and arbitrary transitive coverage; admit one-hop verify* helpers only when their result reaches returned passed.

action.action_summary: Implemented semantic assert-and-exit classification and bounded helper dataflow; resolved all historical 46 execution-only cases.

lesson: Verification coverage must be based on the service result controlling failure, not on a verify-* filename; helper coverage additionally requires evidence that the helper result reaches the returned pass gate.
